serviceMethods.get: get() -> Promise<Entitlement>; schema-only normalized frozen value; rejected/expired/revoked cache becomes local-free
serviceMethods.status: status() -> Promise<internal status>; tier, reason, revocationVersion, trustedNowMs, lastTrustedVerifiedAt, exportsAllowed, existingRecordsAllowed, previewAllowed, deletionAllowed
serviceMethods.getSnapshot: getSnapshot({limits?, requiredCapabilities?} = {}) -> Promise<EntitlementSnapshot>; default requested limits are product hard budgets; frozen including nested values
serviceMethods.admitRun: admitRun(template) -> Promise<EntitlementSnapshot>; consumes template.limits and template.requiredCapabilities without mutating template
serviceMethods.admitTemplate: admitTemplate(request) -> Promise<EntitlementSnapshot>; resolves request.template.templateId or request.templateId; public preflight checks current capacity and returns quota. Optional {...request, tx, snapshot} bridge rechecks the same quota in the actual template write transaction; snapshot must be issued by this live service instance
serviceMethods.install: install(claim) -> Promise<Entitlement>; real signature verification and trusted clock.trustedNow required; invalid import rejects without replacing a previously valid claim
serviceMethods.refresh: refresh() -> Promise<Entitlement>; reverify cached signed claim and require fresh trusted time; may clear a rollback freeze only after authoritative time reaches durable high water
serviceMethods.revoke: revoke(signedEvidence) -> Promise<Entitlement>; signature/identity/future-time validation and strictly increasing revocationVersion required

entryPoint.errors: Policy failures use FoundationError E_ENTITLEMENT; frozen shared schema validation may use E_SCHEMA. Native crypto verification/import failures are normalized to E_ENTITLEMENT.

integration.claimRun: Call await entitlement.admitRun(template), persist that exact EntitlementSnapshot with the approved run and retain it unchanged after license expiry, revocation or grace expiration. Run hard budgets, stop and origin authority still apply.
integration.host: Call getSnapshot() for the schema value; call status() separately for downgrade reason. Never expose clock.trustedNow or keys injection through untrusted runtime messages.
saveTemplate: Main broker's accepted integration: outside the actual IDB write transaction obtain quota = await entitlement.getSnapshot(); pass that exact object through the second trusted context. Caller-provided snapshots are rejected. The optional public admitTemplate(request) preflight is also available.

Within storage's actual templates+entitlements readwrite transaction, call await entitlement.admitTemplate({...request, tx, snapshot: quota}) and pass returned maxSavedTemplates into storage's quota/CAS check before the template put.
Preflight alone does not reserve a template slot. Actual count/check/put must share one write transaction. No WebCrypto await occurs in this service's optional transaction bridge.

Only live metadata heads consume quota in the shared repository layout; retained immutable revision rows do not. Existing template revisions can be edited without consuming another ID. If entitlement revision/freshness changed, prepare a new quota.
integration.clock: Function clock is wall time only. Object clock supports now() -> epoch-ms, monotonicNow() -> nonnegative elapsed-ms, trustedNow() -> epoch-ms or Promise<epoch-ms>. Missing monotonicNow uses performance.now. Missing trustedNow cannot establish/refresh Pro. Production default uses Date.now/performance.now and has no trusted online verification source.
integration.keys: keys is an explicit map {keyId:{issuer,jwk:publicP256Jwk}}. Entries are copied at service construction, issuers and subjects are bound, private JWK d is rejected. Production TRUSTED_KEYS is an empty package-fixed frozen allowlist because no real issuer/public key has been provisioned. Default stays Free. TEST_ONLY keys are injected only by the Node test file.

persistence.owner: Provided shared storage service; this module never calls indexedDB.open or owns another connection
persistence.key: Explicit subject string, exactly; one internal entitlement-policy row per subject
persistence.externalSchema: Internal persistence record is not returned as Entitlement and does not extend frozen schema.
persistence.transactions: Crypto verification/digest complete outside write transactions. Commit CAS checks entitlement revision, merges durable time high water, and samples clock again. Template bridge reads the service-issued ticket and current durable state, counts heads and puts only the entitlement observation in the caller's transaction.
persistence.resultRetention: Entitlement code never reads, writes, deletes or restricts records/pageSnapshots/exportJobs/artifacts. Preview/retrieval/export/deletion remain allowed regardless of tier. Actual reader pins, tombstones and seven-day cleanup are owned by storage/runtime, not this component.

signature.encoding: Exactly 64-byte IEEE-P1363 R||S, canonical unpadded base64url of length 86; DER, wrong hash, alternate trailing bits, padding and invalid signature bytes rejected
signature.canonicalPayload: All Entitlement fields except signature, verification, verifiedAt, lastTrustedTime. Thus tier/formatVersion/issuer/subject/audience/features/issuedAt/expiresAt/keyId/revocationVersion are signed.
signature.metadataTrust: Caller-provided verification/verifiedAt/lastTrustedTime never establishes trust or refreshes offline age. Schema-valid metadata is overwritten for output from private durable policy state.

revocationEvidenceBridge.subject: exact bound subject
revocationEvidenceBridge.revocationVersion: safe nonnegative integer, strictly greater than durable version
revocationEvidenceBridge.signature: same 64-byte P1363 base64url; signs canonical entire evidence except signature

signature.revocationSemantics: Reject stale license versions. Signed revocation revokes claims through its version; only a later valid signed license with a greater version can restore Pro. Cached claim and revocation signatures are reverified on new policy reads.
signature.signingOperations: No product signing code, private keys, billing, account flow, network service or dynamic code execution. Signing/key generation exists only in the test process.

timeAndLimits.expiry: Now must be strictly less than expiresAt. Grace is an additional inclusive <=72h condition; it never extends license expiry. Future issuedAt and impossible calendar dates reject.
timeAndLimits.rollback: Wall or monotonic regression freezes new Pro and persists the freeze across service reload. Only explicit trusted refresh at/after durable time high water may recover it. Integer monotonic samples preserve elapsed time across submillisecond observations.
timeAndLimits.snapshot: effectiveLimits are minimum of caller limits, tier and product hard budgets. approvedCapabilities for Pro are package capabilities intersected with signed features. Required capabilities absent from that grant reject. Free receives package capabilities with free budgets. runExpiryRevokes is always false.
timeAndLimits.productHint: status().reason distinguishes no-claim, invalid-signature-or-claims, invalid-time, expired, revoked, clock-rollback, no-trusted-verification and offline-grace-exceeded. Runtime must show effective budgets and limit_reached rather than silent success.
